name: GAN12 ui MagLev 3x3 (PowerPod, 2026 Edition)
description: The GAN 12 UI MagLev is everything you love about the GAN 12 UI Free Play, but with a MagLev tensioning system! This is the world's first MagLev smart cube, and it is built like a GAN 12, which means performance is top-tier! It comes with a GAN PowerPod for easy charging and storage.
